confirmedImprovement: The former final BeanPostProcessor CGLIB exception is absent.
actualError: BeanCurrentlyInCreationException for cpfCapabilityUsageAspect while CpfControllerPolicyBeanPostProcessor calls a proxied CpfControllerPolicyProperties.isEnabled().
refinedRootCause: A broad AspectJ execution pointcut forces proxy consideration for every matching com.cpf type before the advice can consult runtime capability metadata. Excluding only BeanPostProcessor implementations cannot prevent unrelated infrastructure/configuration proxies or aspect-construction cycles.
requiredOwnerDesign: Use a metadata-aware static Advisor/ClassFilter so only target classes that resolve to an operator-visible capability descriptor are eligible for proxy creation.
closureDecision: The first targeted regression remains useful but is insufficient; F127 is not closed.
